plan: Represent the adapted recipe as freshly built dicts only; never touch the input structures, so print_original returns authored_text byte-for-byte after any number of adaptations.

Compute a single Fraction scale = target_yield / recipe yield and apply it uniformly to all resolved quantities (main, components, and catalog-added ingredients) after substitution resolution, so quantities equal original x replacement factors x scale.

Resolve each ingredient through a substitution chain: while its name is excluded, select the catalog choice with minimal (priority, catalog index); a visited-name set per chain detects cycles and yields 'substitution cycle involving NAME'; a missing choice yields 'no substitution for NAME'.

Accumulate substitution side effects in a per-section ledger: chosen catalog IDs (in application order), wording {old,new} pairs, equipment additions/removals, and additional ingredients; additional ingredients are recursively resolved under the same exclusions/catalog with the inherited visited set, supporting chained adaptation and reintroduced-exclusion detection.

Collect impossibility reasons exhaustively: process every ingredient even after a failure and always check final equipment (base + additions - removals) against available_equipment, so the sorted reasons list contains every independently applicable reason, not merely the first.

Suppress optional components that cannot be adapted (substitution failure or unavailable equipment) with a sorted warning instead of failing the whole recipe; non-optional component failures contribute reasons.

Assemble the final recipe with sorted equipment, wording-rewritten instruction strings, target yield, and sorted warnings; return {possible, recipe, choices, warnings, reasons} with recipe=null and sorted reasons when impossible.

Verify with an executable __main__ self-test covering: 3->5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment change, reintroduced exclusion, multiple simultaneous reasons, cycle detection, deterministic priority tie-break, and byte-for-byte original printing with input immutability.
mechanisms: immutable-input adaptation (all outputs freshly constructed; authored_text passthrough)
uniform Fraction yield-scaling factor applied post-resolution
per-ingredient substitution chain with visited-set cycle detection
deterministic catalog selection by (priority, catalog index)
per-section effect ledger (choice IDs, wording pairs, equipment deltas, additional ingredients)
recursive resolution of additional ingredients under inherited visited set
exhaustive reason collection (all ingredients + equipment checked independently)
sorted final assembly (equipment, warnings, reasons) for deterministic output
